objective: Close the remaining ways a repository can pass the untracked check on .claude/settings.local.json and steer bare setup to local scope.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-scope, branch release/0.3.0/feat/installed-scope-default, head b9464e3 (committed; your edits are a new change on top).

Blocking security finding: a repository can commit .claude as a submodule gitlink (mode 160000) whose checkout holds settings.local.json. git ls-files --cached -- .claude/settings.local.json in the superproject then prints nothing and exits 0, so tracked() (packages/runtime/src/setup/scope.ts:177) says untracked and local is inferred. Treat the file as repository-controlled when any index entry exists at or above it inside the work tree (for example git ls-files --cached --stage -- .claude lists the gitlink), and also when .claude is itself inside a different git repository than the folder (rev-parse --show-toplevel from .claude differs). Verify the gitlink behavior with a real git repository and a submodule in a temporary folder in a test.

Case variants: on case-insensitive file systems a tracked .claude/Settings.Local.json is read but the literal pathspec misses it; make the check case-insensitive (the :(icase,literal) pathspec magic or a case-insensitive comparison over git ls-files output) and test it by committing a differently cased name.

Riders: when git fails (non-zero exit other than a clean empty answer), the notice must say git could not answer, not that git tracks the file (scope.ts:208); add the notice assertion to the fail-closed test. Name the known limit in docs/usage.md and the scope.ts comment: an archive that ships its own .git with an index that omits the file still counts as untracked. Bring docs/components.md:64 and :75 in line with the rule (trusted git work tree, untracked file).
constraints: Before anything else, run `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in your worktree, because node_modules is not shared between worktrees; the prepare step installing lefthook hooks is expected.
Make no git writes (no commit, add, checkout, stash, branch) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; the root commits. Report your changed paths.

Follow the repository rules in .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md of the worktree: Effect for effects and errors with tagged errors (no try/catch, new Promise, Promise statics or async functions in runtime and CLI source), Effect Schema at data boundaries with onExcessProperty error, Bun APIs and the Bun Shell, JSDoc on every exported function and type.
Testing is unit tests and recorded or synthesized fixtures only: never start pi, a Pi session, T3 Code or a Kimi request.

Gates, run in your worktree: `bunx --no-install mise run build` (commit-ready generated output; the tree must have no unexplained changes after it) and `bunx --no-install mise run verify` (type-check, lint, format check, tests) must exit 0. Give the command, exit code and test counts.

Write `git diff` of your change (after the build) to a file outside the repository in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad and give its path as diff-file evidence.
Build only what the Assignment asks; name any further improvement in the report instead of adding it.
Report in under 400 words; put long logs in a file in the scratchpad above and give its path.
The generated packages/integrations/claude/dist and packages/integrations/pi/dist are rewritten by mise run build; include those regenerated files in your changed paths.

A tracked local settings file with a different letter case never infers local, with a test
A git failure gives user with a notice that git could not answer, with a test asserting the notice
docs/usage.md, docs/components.md and the scope.ts comment state the rule and the archive limit
mise run build leaves no unexplained changes and mise run verify exits 0
No test is weakened or removed to pass; every new behavior has a test that fails without it
